title: Trump adds drones, snipers and ammunition to plans for Washington triumphal arch
summary_full: US President Trump announced plans to transform a proposed triumphal arch into a military complex. This new facility will house and deploy drones and snipers for national security. The structure is planned near Arlington Memorial Bridge, adjacent to the cemetery. Veterans have filed lawsuits challenging the arch's construction and sightline disruption. The Federal Aviation Administration has cleared aviation concerns for the proposed arch.
